title: Privacy Policy
description: How Sellwood Medical Clinic collects, uses and protects your personal information on its website.
intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy.
blocks: Sellwood Medical Clinic is committed to protecting your privacy. This statement covers our website. By using the site, you agree to the practices described here.
We collect personal information such as your email, name, home or work address and phone number.
We collect anonymous demographic information such as ZIP code, age, gender, preferences and interests.
We automatically collect technical data such as your IP address, browser type, domain names, access times and the address of the site that referred you.
Information you post on public message boards may be collected and used by others. Please read the privacy statements of any sites we link to. We are not responsible for those sites.
We use your information to run the website, deliver the services you ask for, tell you about other products or services, and run surveys.
We do not sell, rent or lease customer lists to third parties.
We may share data with trusted partners for statistical analysis, email or postal mail, customer support or deliveries. These partners must keep your information confidential.
We do not use or share sensitive information, such as race, religion or political affiliation, without your clear consent.
We share personal information without notice only when the law requires it.
We use cookies to personalize your online experience. A cookie is a text file that can only be read by the server of the domain that issued it.

We store personally identifiable information on secure servers with controlled access. When we send personal information to other sites, we use encryption such as the Secure Socket Layer (SSL) protocol.
We may update this statement from time to time. Please review it now and then.

title: Terms & Conditions
description: The terms for using the Sellwood Medical Clinic website.
intro: Please read these terms before using our website.
blocks: You may use this website on the condition that you accept these terms, conditions and notices without change. Using the site means you agree to all of them.
We may change the terms, conditions and notices, including any charges for using the site.
The site may link to outside websites that we do not control. We are not responsible for their content, changes or transmissions. A link does not mean we endorse the site.
You may not use the site for unlawful or prohibited purposes. You may not damage, overload or harm the site, interfere with others, or reach materials that we did not mean to make available.
Any forums, chat areas or bulletin boards are for proper, related messages only. You may not:
Harass or defame others, or violate their legal rights
Post inappropriate, obscene, infringing or unlawful material
Advertise goods or services for business, unless allowed
Run surveys, contests, pyramid schemes or chain letters
Collect other people’s information, including email addresses, without consent
We do not have to monitor these services, but we may review, remove or limit material and end access at any time.
Information on the site may contain mistakes and may change at any time. Please do not rely on it for personal, medical, legal or financial decisions. Talk to a professional about your own situation.

We and our suppliers make no promises about the content of the site and are not liable for damages, to the fullest extent the law allows. If you are not happy with the site, your only remedy is to stop using it.

title: Prescription Policy
description: Refill and prescription rules at Sellwood Medical Clinic, including timing and how to request a change.
intro: How to request refills and prescription changes.
blocks: We encourage refills at your appointments. Please bring your medications to each visit.
Refill requests received after 2:00 pm on Thursdays, after hours, or on weekends or holidays are processed the next business day.
If your prescription is current and the dose is not changing, call your regular pharmacy. The pharmacy will contact us.
Some conditions need an office visit before we can approve a refill. This helps us support your care and check how well the medicine is working.
A provider must review and approve every refill. Please ask 48 to 72 hours ahead.
For a new pharmacy, a change in prescription, or a medicine that needs a written prescription, create a patient case in the patient portal. This also takes 48 to 72 hours.

title: Billing Department
description: Billing answers for Sellwood Medical Clinic patients: well visits, vaccines, labs, copays and payment policies.
intro: Clear answers to common billing questions.
blocks: Well visits are generally covered as preventative care. Referrals, orders, medications, extra testing or other non-preventative care may be billed as diagnostic care, which usually needs a separate office visit.

If you need diagnostic care during a well visit, we may add an office visit charge so everything can happen in one appointment. You can see an itemized breakdown on the Billing tab of the patient portal.
Knowing if your insurance is in-network with our clinic
Knowing which lab is in-network with your insurance
Knowing which pharmacy is in-network with your insurance
Knowing if your plan allows one well visit per calendar year, or needs a full year between visits
Lab work is billed directly by the lab that does it. We cannot see lab billing or answer questions about lab charges.

Commercial vaccines are supplied and billed through VaxCare, which bills in-network plans directly. If VaxCare asks you for insurance information, please answer them directly. Contact us only if a vaccine claim was processed as out-of-network.
Copays are due at the time of service.
Past-due balances sent to an outside collections agency may have extra fees.
Provider time of more than 5 minutes outside a scheduled appointment may have extra fees.

title: Medical Forms
description: Download and complete Sellwood Medical Clinic patient forms before your visit.
intro: Fill in your forms before your visit to save time.
blocks: Please review and complete the forms that fit your visit before you come. Questions? Call 503-595-9300. Oregon law ORS 441.098 covers patient rights and responsibilities.
Please bring your insurance card and photo ID to your appointment.

An Advance Directive lets you name a health care representative to make decisions if you cannot. Please bring a printed copy to your next visit or mail it to us. Official Oregon POLST forms are available at the office.

title: Notice of Privacy Practices
seo: Notice of Privacy Practices | Sellwood Medical Clinic
description: How Sellwood Medical Clinic may use and share your medical information, and how you can access it.
blocks: This notice explains how your medical information may be used and shared, and how you can get access to it. Questions? Call 503-595-9300 or write to 8332 SE 13th Avenue, Portland, OR 97202.
Clinic employees, staff and other personnel follow these practices.
It covers your health, treatment and billing records in written, electronic or spoken form.
We are required by law to give you this notice.
How we may use and share information
Treatment: sharing information among care providers and with outside providers, pharmacies and labs.
Payment: billing you, your insurer or a third party.
Health care operations: running the clinic, reviewing staff and improving care.
Fundraising: we may contact you. You can opt out by writing to us.
Subject to legal limits, we may share information to:
Prevent a serious threat to health or safety
Support approved research (we ask your permission if you could be identified)
Help with organ and tissue donation
Respond to military, veteran, national security or intelligence matters
Support health oversight audits and investigations
Work with coroners and medical examiners
Share information that does not identify you
Involve family or friends in your care, based on your agreement, your lack of objection, or our professional judgment

Other uses need your written or verbal permission, which you can take back in writing. Specially protected information, such as substance use, mental or behavioral health, or reproductive health information, may need specific written permission.

We will not use or share protected health information to investigate or punish anyone for seeking, getting, providing or helping with lawful reproductive health care. There are some exceptions and conditions.
Inspect and copy: send a written request to the Leadership Team. Copy fees may apply, and you can ask for electronic copies. A licensed professional can review a denial.
Amend: ask for changes by emailing mrecords@sellwoodmd.com. If we deny it, you can send a rebuttal of two pages or fewer.
Accounting of disclosures: ask for a list of certain disclosures for up to six years. The first list in 12 months is free.
Request restrictions: ask us to limit certain uses or sharing. We must agree if you pay out of pocket and ask us not to send the information to your health plan, with some legal exceptions.
Confidential communications: ask us to contact you in a certain way or place. We will not ask why and will meet reasonable requests.
Paper copy: you can ask for a paper copy of this notice at any time.
We may change this notice, and the change will apply to existing and future information. We post the current notice with its effective date and will tell you about important changes.
We will tell you if a breach of your health information happens.

You may file a complaint with us or with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights (Region X, Seattle). You will not be penalized for filing a complaint. Our phone is 503-595-9300.

We follow federal civil rights laws and do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, age, disability or sex. We provide free aids, services and qualified interpreters for people with disabilities or limited English. You can file a grievance in person, by mail or by email.
